candidates.title: Supreme Court to study plea for recall of split verdict on EC appointment law
candidates.excerpt: The Supreme Court has agreed to examine a plea concerning a recent split verdict related to a 2023 election law. This law alters the appointment process for the Chief Election Commissioner and other election commissioners. The split verdict occurred between Justices Dipankar Datta and Satish Chandra Sharma on whether to refer the matter to a larger Constitution bench.

candidates.title: Delhi Police likely to file FIR over alleged assault on police during Congress protest
candidates.excerpt: Delhi Police is reviewing videos to identify protesters involved in the alleged assault during a Congress protest. Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi were detained for defying police orders while attempting to proceed to Jantar Mantar. Police are also taking action against misleading social media posts regarding their conduct during the protest. Earlier, an FIR was lodged against Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi for forcibly entering Akashvani Bhawan.
